creator.title: About the creator
creator.role: Founder, AIdeazz AI Lab · Former IT executive and Chief Legal Officer in national e-government
creator.name: Elena Revicheva
creator.story1: In 2022 I moved to Panama with three generations of my family: my one-year-old daughter and my parents. None of us spoke Spanish. Together we learned what it means to navigate everyday life without speaking the local language: the doctor's appointment you cannot fully follow, the meeting at your child's school, unfamiliar paperwork, and the small daily moments that make you feel like an outsider.
creator.story2: Life in a new country doesn't happen by appointment. It happens everywhere: at the pharmacy counter, on the phone with the landlord, at the roadside, at the school gate. I needed help right there, in my pocket, any hour of the day: a companion I could trust to tell me the truth and give me the exact words people really use here. Not a textbook phrase, but what to say, and how to say it, in that moment. No app could do that. So I built it.
creator.meansTitle: What that means for your family:
creator.m1: EspaLuz grew out of real family life, not an abstract idea of language learning. She helps your family handle everyday situations while learning in both languages.
creator.m2: My background in legal governance and public digital services shapes how I build: privacy and reliability first.
creator.m3Lead: Built to grow with your family.
creator.m3: On WhatsApp, Telegram and the web, day and night. Children have their own class with Pere and Titi, where they talk, read, trace letters and earn stars.
creator.closing: EspaLuz started with my own family's need to feel at home in Panama. Today I build it so other families can find that feeling too.
creator.connectBody: For partnerships, press or work with AIdeazz AI Lab: my portfolio and professional profile are here.
creator.buildBody: The future of learning is warm, culturally aware and family-focused.

lab.title: How EspaLuz is built
lab.intro: EspaLuz is a personal AI companion for families making a life in Spanish. AIdeazz AI Lab designs, builds and runs it every day.
lab.l1Lead: A companion that knows your family.
lab.l1: She remembers who is who, each person's level and what you are working on, on WhatsApp, Telegram and the web, so every conversation picks up where the last one ended.
lab.l2: She answers in Spanish and English at each person's pace: as Pere and Titi for a child, as a calm, practical guide for an adult.
lab.l3Lead: More than one AI behind every answer.
lab.l3: Several leading AI models stand ready. If one is down, the next one answers, so your family is never left waiting.
lab.l4: Everything on this page is something EspaLuz already does.
